question: There are three pipes K, L and M. Pipe K can fill a tank in 45 minutes and pipe L can fill the same tank in one hour Pipe M can empty the same tank, when filled, in 1 hour 45 minutes. If all three pipes are opened together when the tank is empty, then the tank will be filled in:
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by pipe K to fill the tank = 45 minutes.

Time taken by pipe L to fill the tank = 60 minutes.

Time taken by pipe M to empty the tank = 105 minutes.

**Formula Used:**

Rate of filling or emptying = 1 / Time taken.

**Calculation:**

Rate of filling by pipe K = 1 / 45
